verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents approval flows for invoice payments and customizable roles and permissions, including employee permissions on payments, so a finance lead can plausibly designate who approves payments. The evidence does not show how approval permissions are configured specifically for payments, or that approvers can approve and send with one click. Missing for 10: documented payment-approver permission setup, one-click approve-and-send workflow, approval rule details (thresholds, multi-step), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click

citations.quote: Automate invoice payments and approval flows
Add additional security with employee permissions and invoice audit trails.
